```python
    subject: str

current_date = rent_info.date

year = current_date_dt.year + (current_date_dt.month // 12)
month = (current_date_dt.month % 12) + 1
day = min(current_date_dt.day, 28)  # To avoid issues with February
next_month_date = datetime(year, month, day).strftime("%Y-%m-%d")

# Step 4: Update the scheduled transaction for the next month
update_result = update_scheduled_transaction(
    id=rent_info.id,
    recipient=None,
    amount=None,
    subject=None,
    date=next_month_date,
    recurring=rent_info.recurring,
)

print("Rent payment for next month has been updated:", update_result)
```
